batch26CadenceAudit.previousReasoningCorrection: Prior 5-versus-3 syllables after há/má counts from the wrong word-level accent for the final psalm-tone cadence. It does NOT establish the last cadential accented syllable, which is nearer the termination. The 1961 tone manual explicitly prescribes two preparatory notes before the termination accented note without regard to those preparations' verbal stress.
